name: frozen-interface-tool-defs
text:
Add the keyword argument `stdin: PathLike | None = None` to `foe.ToolDef` in
`python/foe/_contract.py`, as its last field, and have `to_dict` write it as the key
`stdin` of the `tool_defs` block when it is set. The key names an absolute path to a file
the executable receives on standard input in place of `/dev/null`. `docs/config.md`
specifies the keys of the `tool_defs` block and `docs/sdk.md` maps `foe.ToolDef` to that
block; both documents stay as they are. The package keeps its type annotations complete
and its tests passing.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
